name: Halden Over-Ear Headphones
description: Closed-back wireless headphones with active noise cancelling, 40 hours of battery and soft protein-leather cushions that stay comfortable on long flights.

name: Pebble True Wireless Earbuds
description: Small, light earbuds with a pocket-sized charging case. Six hours per charge, IPX4 sweat resistance and a decent call mic.

name: Studio Monitor Speakers (Pair)
description: Five inch bookshelf monitors with a flat response, front bass ports and both RCA and optical inputs. Good for a desk or a small living room.

name: Field Portable Bluetooth Speaker
description: Rugged speaker wrapped in recycled fabric. Floats, survives drops and lasts about a weekend on one charge.

name: Linen Button-Down Shirt
description: Relaxed shirt in washed European linen. Gets softer every wash. Mother-of-pearl buttons and a slightly shorter hem so it works untucked.

name: Heavyweight Cotton Tee
description: A 240 gsm organic cotton t-shirt with a boxy fit and a ribbed collar that keeps its shape.

name: Merino Crew Sweater
description: Fine-gauge merino wool sweater. Warm without bulk, naturally odour resistant, and fine to wear straight against skin.

name: Waxed Canvas Chore Jacket
description: Four pocket jacket in waxed cotton canvas that shrugs off light rain. Corduroy collar and brass snaps.

name: Everyday Canvas Sneakers
description: Low-top sneakers with a vulcanised rubber sole and a cushioned cork insole. Comes in off-white and slate.

name: Trail Running Shoes
description: Grippy lugged outsole, rock plate and a breathable mesh upper. Built for muddy hill runs and long dirt trails.

name: Leather Chelsea Boots
description: Full-grain leather boots with elastic side panels and a Goodyear welted sole that can be resoled.

name: Pour-Over Coffee Kettle
description: Gooseneck kettle with a thermometer in the lid. Holds 1 litre and works on gas, electric and induction.

name: Burr Coffee Grinder
description: Conical steel burrs with 40 grind settings, from espresso fine to French press coarse. Quiet motor and a static-free catch cup.

name: Cast Iron Skillet 26cm
description: Pre-seasoned cast iron pan that goes from stove to oven to table. It will outlive you if you dry it properly.

name: Stoneware Dinner Set (12 pc)
description: Four dinner plates, four side plates and four bowls in a speckled matte glaze. Dishwasher and microwave safe.

name: Chef's Knife 20cm
description: Hand-sharpened Japanese steel blade with a walnut handle. Holds an edge well and is easy to hone at home.

name: Arc Floor Lamp
description: Brushed brass floor lamp with a marble base and a linen shade. Warm, soft light for reading corners.

name: Ceramic Table Lamp
description: Hand-thrown ceramic base in a sand glaze with a pleated cotton shade. Each one is slightly different.

name: Wool Throw Blanket
description: Woven lambswool throw in a simple herringbone pattern. 130 x 180 cm, big enough for the sofa.

name: Linen Bedding Set (Queen)
description: Stone-washed linen duvet cover and two pillowcases. Breathable in summer, cosy in winter.

name: Terracotta Planter Set
description: Three unglazed terracotta pots with saucers, 12, 16 and 20 cm. Drainage holes included.

name: Mechanical Keyboard 75%
description: Compact keyboard with hot-swap switches, a gasket mount and PBT keycaps. Works over USB-C or Bluetooth.

name: Wireless Ergonomic Mouse
description: Sculpted mouse with a thumb rest, silent clicks and a battery that lasts about three months.

name: 27" 4K Monitor
description: IPS panel with 99% sRGB coverage, USB-C power delivery at 65W and a height adjustable stand.

name: Smart Watch Series 3
description: Always-on AMOLED display, GPS, heart rate and sleep tracking. Around six days of battery in normal use.

name: Portable Power Bank 20000mAh
description: Charges a laptop over USB-C at 45W and two phones at the same time. Fits in a jacket pocket, just.

name: Dot Grid Notebook A5
description: 192 pages of 100 gsm paper that handles fountain pens without bleeding. Lay-flat binding and a ribbon marker.

name: Brass Fountain Pen
description: Solid brass pen that develops a patina over time. Steel fine nib, takes standard international cartridges.

name: Leather Desk Organiser
description: Vegetable-tanned leather tray for keys, pens and cables. Darkens nicely with use.

name: Ultralight Daypack 20L
description: Ripstop nylon backpack that weighs 380 g. Padded laptop sleeve, side bottle pockets and a sternum strap.

name: Insulated Water Bottle 750ml
description: Double-walled steel bottle that keeps water cold for 24 hours. Leak-proof lid with a carry loop.

name: Two-Person Camping Tent
description: Freestanding tent with two doors and two vestibules. Packs down to the size of a loaf of bread.

name: Yoga Mat 5mm
description: Natural rubber mat with a grippy top layer and alignment lines. Heavy enough to stay put.

name: Adjustable Dumbbells (Pair)
description: Dial from 2.5 kg to 24 kg in a few seconds. Replaces a whole rack in a corner of the room.

name: The Quiet Kitchen (Cookbook)
description: 120 weeknight recipes built around a handful of pantry staples. Hardback, lies flat on the counter.

name: Small Spaces: A Design Handbook
description: Practical layouts, storage ideas and lighting advice for flats under 600 square feet. Lots of floor plans.

name: Natural Soy Candle
description: Hand-poured soy wax candle with cedar, vetiver and a little smoke. About 50 hours of burn time.

name: Everyday Face Moisturiser
description: Light, fragrance-free moisturiser with niacinamide and ceramides. Sinks in fast and works under sunscreen.

name: Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50
description: Zinc based sunscreen with no white cast on most skin tones. Water resistant for 40 minutes.

name: Bamboo Bath Towel Set
description: Two bath towels and two hand towels in a soft bamboo-cotton blend. Quick drying and very absorbent.
